title: SimpleTrashCommand
description: A simple trash command that allows you to put items into an inventory to delete them.
body:
**SimpleTrashCommand** is a basic plugin designed for those who want a simple /trash command to remove items out of their inventory.

# Versions

This plugin supports 1.21 - 1.21.11 and can be used on Paper, Spigot and Bukkit Minecraft servers.

# Features

- Simple and easy-to-use /trash command
- Opens a trash inventory GUI
- Permission support (``simpletrashcommand.use``)
- Lightweight with minimal performance impact
- No complicated setup required
- Supports modern Minecraft versions

# Installation

1. Download the latest release.
2. Place the plugin JAR into your server's plugins folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. Use /trash in-game.
